package.name: ml_localization_manager
package.description: Localization Manager (state machine node, ml_localization_manager): monitors the ICP node health (/ml_localization/status), drives SC relocalization (/trigger_relocalization, served by ml_relocalization/relocalization_node) on cold start or LOST, validates reloc results (state / odom-sync / jump gates) and publishes only validated poses as /ml_localization/reloc_pose to the Global EKF, or performs optional startup-only set_pose initialization, then calls /ml_localization/start_tracking after confirming EKF agreement. Optional init_pose parameter injects an initial map pose on the first valid EKF odometry (reloc first wins). No ScanContext in this package.
